function o.bind(keys, description, dispatcher, options)
  local opts = options or {}

  if description then
    opts.description = description
  end

  dispatcher = command_from(dispatcher, description)

  if type(dispatcher) == "string" then
    dispatcher = hl.dsp.exec_cmd(dispatcher)
  end

  hl.bind(keys, dispatcher, opts)
end

function o.rebind(keys, description, dispatcher, options)
  hl.unbind(keys)
  o.bind(keys, description, dispatcher, options)
end

-- Each monitor has workspaces 1-10 of its own; see default/hypr/monitor-workspaces.lua.
for workspace = 1, 10 do
  local key = "code:" .. tostring(workspace + 9)
  o.bind("SUPER + " .. key, "Switch to workspace " .. workspace, o.workspaces.focus(workspace))
  o.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + " .. key, "Move window to workspace " .. workspace, o.workspaces.move_window(workspace))
  o.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + " .. key, "Move window silently to workspace " .. workspace, o.workspaces.move_window(workspace, false))
end

#!/bin/bash

# omarchy:summary=Take a screenshot
# omarchy:group=capture
# omarchy:args=[smart|region|windows|fullscreen|scroll] [copy|save]
# omarchy:examples=omarchy screenshot | omarchy capture screenshot region
# omarchy:aliases=omarchy screenshot

if [[ -n ${OMARCHY_SCREENSHOT_DIR:-} && -z ${OMASNAP_SCREENSHOT_DIR:-} ]]; then
  export OMASNAP_SCREENSHOT_DIR="$OMARCHY_SCREENSHOT_DIR"
fi

# --notify announces saved shots with Open and Edit buttons instead of a
# preview. Omasnap reads that toast's text from this catalog itself:
#   omarchy-i18n capture.screenshotSaved, omarchy-i18n capture.screenshotSavedCopied,
#   omarchy-i18n capture.screenshotOpen, omarchy-i18n capture.screenshotEdit
omasnap_args=(--notify)
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    copy) omasnap_args+=(--copy) ;;
    save) omasnap_args+=(--save) ;;
    slurp) ;;
    *) omasnap_args+=("$arg") ;;
  esac
done

exec omasnap "${omasnap_args[@]}"
